goal: Add a bounded UTF-8 parser with clear errors
assumptions: The existing parser has no external callers

steps.title: Implement the parser
steps.instructions: Validate input size and return structured errors for malformed records.

steps.title: Add parser regression coverage
steps.instructions: Cover valid input, malformed input and the maximum supported input size.

risks: The input limit could reject previously accepted files

acceptance_criteria.description: Invalid input returns errors without panicking
